plan.archetype: Flexible poison scaling with efficient damage and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade damage and poison engines, secure dexterity and efficient block, save defensive potions, and enter healthy. Crossing 160 HP cancels only one attack.
plan.summary: Add reliable early damage before stacking scaling powers. Build poison and dexterity without forcing synergy, remove dead draws, avoid costly elites, and balance upgrades with enough healing for the boss.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with efficient attacks, dexterity defense, and draw
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy; upgrade poison, Footwork, and Neutralize when safe. Add faster damage and efficient defense. Crossing 160 HP cancels one attack, not the fight.
plan.summary: Heal now and prioritize early recovery. Use the poison potion if needed against the forced elite. Remove Injury, add efficient damage and draw, strengthen poison scaling, and smith only with sufficient health.
